name: Velociraptor
description: A velociraptor is feathered carnivorous dinosaur known for its speed and agility. It is a skilled packhunter, using its sharp claws and teeth to take down prey much larger than itself.

actions.name: Stalk
actions.description: When a creature leaves the velociraptor's area of control, the velociraptor can move up to 4 units towards that creature.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The velociraptor bites a creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition if the attack was not completely mitigated.

actions.name: Rear Talons
actions.description: The velociraptor rakes the talons on it's foot against a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Latching Bite
actions.description: After hitting a creature with the Bite action, the velociraptor can latch onto the target by making a Strength Check against an opposing Acrobatics or Athletics Check. While attached in this way, the target has a 1d4 penalty to all defense checks and must use an Action to force another check to try to escape. The Velociraptor cannot take the Move Action or use the Bite Action while attached in this way.

traits.name: Pack Hunter
traits.description: The velociraptor gains a 1d6 bonus to damage with their bite attack against a creature that has an ally adjacent to it.
